changeSet.author: trainer
changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS SELECT t.trade_date, c.region, i.asset_class, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED') AS matched_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED')) AS open_breaks, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.quantity * t.price), 0)::NUMERIC, 2), 0) AS total_notional COALESCENCE( ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0 ) AS match_rate_pct FROM trades t JOIN counterparties c on c.id = t.counterparty_id join instruments i on i.id = t.instrument_id left join recon_breaks rb on rb.trade_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.trade_date, c.region, i.asset_class with no data;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary (trade_date, region, asset_class);

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
